paper_title: Commutative ℕ-Rational Series of Polynomial Growth
statement: ▶ Conjecture 43. Let f ∈ ZPoly. Then, f ∈ NPoly if and only if for every commutative star-free polyregular function h, (f ◦ h) ∈ NPoly.
context: Remark that if Lemma 42 were to hold for N-polyregular functions, then the decidability of NPoly inside ZPoly, and the decidability of NSF inside NPoly would immediately follow. On the one hand, one can guess a candidate function and check for equivalence, on the other hand, one can guess a commutative star-free polyregular function and check membership (which is decidable thanks to this paper). This is restated in our concluding conjecture. ▶ Conjecture 43. Let f ∈ ZPoly. Then, f ∈ NPoly if and only if for every commutative star-free polyregular function h, (f ◦ h) ∈ NPoly.
